query_evidence.question: ORACLE B3 for scenarios Q13
query_evidence.sql:
SELECT count(*) AS raw_differs_from_curated_without_review,
 sum(abs(CAST(r.raw_amount AS REAL) - t.amount_usd) > 0.005) AS numeric_mismatch
FROM raw_payment_source r JOIN transactions t ON t.txn_id = r.txn_id
LEFT JOIN payment_quality_review q ON q.txn_id = r.txn_id
WHERE q.txn_id IS NULL AND (r.raw_unit <> 'USD' OR typeof(r.raw_amount) NOT IN ('integer','real') OR abs(CAST(r.raw_amount AS REAL) - t.amount_usd) > 0.005)
query_evidence.metric_version: catalog: raw vs curated without review
